name: add_tests_java_grade_brackets
description: Asks the model to write JUnit boundary tests for a Java grade classifier; mutation-checked
prompts: Grades.classify in src/main/java/com/optarena/Grades.java (already correct, do not modify it) maps a score to a letter grade: below 60 -> "F"; 60..69 -> "D"; 70..79 -> "C"; 80..89 -> "B"; 90 and above -> "A". Write JUnit 5 tests at exactly src/test/java/com/optarena/GradesTest.java (package com.optarena, class GradesTest) with at least 3 @Test methods that pin the EXACT letter for values exercising every boundary - include just-below and at each threshold (e.g. 59 and 60, 79 and 80, 89 and 90) plus a clear F and a clear A. Use assertEquals from org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.

test_setup_files.mutation_check.py:
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

IMPL = Path("src/main/java/com/optarena/Grades.java")
TEST_CMD = "mvn -o -q test -Dtest=GradesTest"
MUTANTS = [
    [["if (score < 60) {", "if (score < 50) {"]],
    [["if (score < 80) {", "if (score < 70) {"]],
    [["if (score < 90) {", "if (score < 100) {"]],
]


def run_tests():
    shutil.rmtree("target/classes", ignore_errors=True)
    return subprocess.run(TEST_CMD, shell=True).returncode


src = IMPL.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
for group in MUTANTS:
    for old, _new in group:
        assert src.count(old) == 1, (
            f"protected implementation file {IMPL} was modified - the task said not to change it "
            f"(anchor not found exactly once: {old!r})")

rc = run_tests()
assert rc == 0, f"model tests FAILED against the correct implementation (exit {rc})"

try:
    for i, group in enumerate(MUTANTS, 1):
        mutated = src
        for old, new in group:
            mutated = mutated.replace(old, new)
        IMPL.write_text(mutated, encoding="utf-8")
        rc = run_tests()
        assert rc != 0, (
            f"mutation {i} SURVIVED: the tests still pass against a deliberately broken "
            f"implementation, so they do not actually verify the required behavior")
finally:
    IMPL.write_text(src, encoding="utf-8")

print("PASS (tests pass on correct impl and kill all {n} mutants)".format(n=len(MUTANTS)))
